title: GenAI Conversational Support & IVR Modernization
situation: Legacy chatbot and IVR stack had low containment, pushing costly volume into human escalation.
approach: Designed and deployed a GenAI-driven Dialogflow CX playbook, built a RAG-based retrieval architecture to ground responses in FAQs, and built an automated testing framework to de-risk releases.
outcome: Chat containment improved from 30% to 45%. The IVR launch hit 53% containment, the highest on record, with zero escalations at release.

title: Transformation as a Service — Value Realization Office
situation: Leadership across three business verticals had no consistent way to see whether transformation initiatives were actually paying off.
approach: Designed KPI dashboards in partnership with senior stakeholders, aligning product metrics to business goals, and acted as the bridge between engineering and business sponsors on requirements and adoption tracking.
outcome: The dashboards became the standard decision-making tool across all three verticals, replacing most manual reporting and supporting a transformation that delivered measurable business value.

title: SMB Identification & Segmentation
situation: Sales and marketing had no reliable way to prioritize which SMB accounts to target, spreading campaign spend thin.
approach: Built clustering-based customer personas from behavioral and demographic data in partnership with sales and marketing, then built a prioritization model to rank high-potential segments.
outcome: Targeted campaigns built on the new segmentation model drove a measurable lift in SMB sales.

title: High-Speed Internet Lead Generation
situation: Acquisition spend on high-speed internet leads was inefficient, with targeting too broad to hit cost or conversion goals.
approach: Spearheaded a machine-learning lead-scoring system, scoping requirements around a fixed acquisition-cost ceiling before optimizing the model, and partnered with engineering to integrate it into the acquisition workflow.
outcome: Targeting efficiency improved and acquisition costs dropped, while lead conversion rose — proving the model paid for itself rather than just improving on paper.
